results.segment: We are sorry for the delay in replying and thank you for your patience.
You must attend a hearing at the tribunal on 14 September 2026.
Please send us a reading from your meter at your earliest convenience.
If you are claiming a single person discount, you must tell us before the end of the billing year.
Never give your bank details to anyone who telephones you claiming to be from this office.
This letter confirms your appointment with the housing officer on 3 June 2026 at 10.30am.

obligations.ask: Attend the appointment with the housing officer
